thread.title: Dow tumbles 160 points in early Tuesday trade as rebound attempt sputters

author: Stocks News Feed
title: Dow tumbles 160 points in early Tuesday trade as rebound attempt sputters
text:
The Dow Jones Industrial Average traded more than 100 points lower Tuesday morning, as a tumble in shares of Boeing Co.
 BA, -3.81%
 and Home Depot Inc.
 HD, -3.00%
 put the kibosh on a rebound attempt by the blue-chip index. Boeing’s share decline was carving about 80 points out of the Dow
 DJIA, -0.55%
 after The Wall Street Journal reported that the aerospace company withheld information about a change to its aircrafts, while Home Depot was retreating even after the home-improvement giant reported better-than-expected third-quarter results. Declines in both companies come after the Dow shed more than 600 points amid a internet and technology -related stock -market rout that was partly prompted by sharp declines in shares of Apple Inc.
 AAPL, +0.20%
 and those for Goldman Sachs Group Inc.
 GS, -0.39%
 Most recently, the Dow was trading 160 points, or 0.6%, lower at 25,210, the S&P 500 index
 SPX, -0.03%
 was down 0.2% at 2,721, while the Nasdaq Composite Index
 COMP, +0.36%
 was clinging to a slight 0.1% gain at 7,210. All three benchmarks finished Monday’s trade sharply lower.
